scope: No download/training/rendering/GPU allocation; geometry-screened and method-development-unused within the audited repository.
selection_rule: hash order within dataset; first 16 Objaverse + first 8 GSO; interleave 2 Objaverse then 1 GSO

failure_policy: All 24 remain in the denominator; log spectral, training, rendering and missing-pair failures; no replacement by either unenrolled candidate.
